integrity: The hexadecimal generators are reconstructed directly from the primary source. Exact finite arithmetic checks rank, self-orthogonality, the source minimum distances, every subspace of \(\mathbb F_2^8\), two equivalent support computations, all generalized Hamming weights, and every extremal-subcode multiplicity.
scientific_limitations: The result is specific to the four generator-matrix representatives printed in arXiv:2511.05440. It does not classify all self-orthogonal codes with the same \([n,8,d]_2\) parameters, establish equivalence classes, or claim global optimality of the higher weights. Exact searches leave a residual risk of unindexed equivalent computations.
title: Complete higher-support profiles of four new dimension-eight self-orthogonal binary codes
